_about: Enemy squads (SPEC §17). Every enemy squad starts on the Enemy Base. How many: squads_per_town × the map's towns (rounded), at least min_squads. Roles in placement order: a number, or "rest" for whatever is left of that total. Leader and base guard hold the base; field squads march out to take buildings (EnemyAI, weights in ai.json). Builds are 4 units with no healers: a stage 3 leader and three stage 2 Serf-line units; [class, row], the first unit able to lead leads.
_victor_pause_ticks: An enemy squad that beats one of yours stands still this many ticks (2 game hours) before moving on, so you can reach it for a second battle (playtest round 10).
_base_revive_ticks: An enemy squad standing on the Enemy Base brings back one fallen unit (leader first, at full HP) every this many ticks (2 game hours). Living units don't heal there (enemy_base rest 0 in buildings.json).
